"''I know you think I'm a coward, Rex. But believe me. I'll fight to my last breath to keep them safe.|Rex and Cut Lawquane|}} '''Cut Lawquane''' was a [[clone trooper]] who fought for the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], Lawquane's [[transport]] was attacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[gunship]]s, leaving his fellow [[soldier]]s either dead or injured. Lawquane fled, [[Desertion|deserting]] the [[Grand Army of the Republic|army]], and later married [[Suu Lawquane]]. The war later [[Battle of Saleucami|made its way]] to [[Saleucami]], where Lawquane, Suu, and his two adopted children lived on their [[Lawquane's Farm|farm]]. Lawquane met [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], who helped defend his [[Lawquane family|family]] and home from [[BX-series droid commando]]s. Rex and Cut overcame their differences, and Rex agreed not to report Cut as a deserter. Sometime during the war, the clones of the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] visited Cut and his family. After [[Order 66]] and the end of the Clone Wars, Rex and the Bad Batch visited Cut in succession - the latter after they had defected from the [[Proclamation of the New Order|newly-formed]] [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] and [[Escape from Kamino|fled]] [[Kamino]]. At this time, the [[Lawquane family|Lawquanes]] left Saleucami, with forged [[chain code]]s. ==Biography== ===Early life and deserting the Republic=== {{Quote|Shortly after the Battle of Geonosis, our troop transport got caught between two Separatist gunships. They fired at us with everything they had. We crashed. Most of us were either dead or severely injured. So when they started working their way through the wounded, killing us off, I knew there was no hope. I ran. It still haunts me.|Cut Lawquane|audio=ItStillHauntsMe-TD.flac|}} Like all [[clone trooper]]s, Cut Lawquane was a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], and was bred in the Republic cloning facility on [[Kamino]]. He was developed within the [[Egg Lab]],{{Film|II}} and injected with an [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chip]] as an embryo, along with all other clones.{{TCW|Fugitive}} After he completed his training, he would join the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and leave Kamino. [[File:Suufamily.png|thumb|left|180px|Cut and his family.]] Shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[The galaxy|galaxy]]-wide [[Clone Wars]], Cut was still serving in the Republic Military. On one of his missions, he boarded a [[troop transport]] along with several other [[trooper]]s. Two [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[gunship]]s cornered and [[Attack on a Republic troop transport|attacked]] the transport, crashing it, and [[Death|killing]] a majority of the clones on board. The [[Battle droid|droids]] then proceeded to comb the wreckage and eliminate any surviving clones. Cut fled, realizing there was no chance of survival if he stayed with his fellow [[soldier]]s. Cut eventually found his way to the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[planet]] of [[Saleucami]], where he met [[Suu Lawquane]], a [[Gender|female]] [[Twi'lek]]. He got to know Suu, and eventually fell in love. The two [[Marriage|married]], and Cut became the [[Parent|stepfather]] of two [[human]]-Twi'lek [[hybrid]] children, [[Shaeeah Lawquane|Shaeeah]] and [[Jek Lawquane|Jek]]. The four lived together on the planet of Saleucami, where the [[Lawquane family|family]] maintained a [[Lawquane's Farm|farm]]. On the farm, the [[Lawquane family|family]] grew crops and raised livestock, such as the [[eopie]]s they kept in their barn. ===Battle of Saleucami=== {{Quote|So... I see the war has finally made its way out here, and I guess I can expect a visit from some droids soon.|Cut Lawquane|}} In [[21 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Landing at Point Rain]]" to [[21 BBY]], and {{HelmetCollectionCite|76|Highlights of the Saga}} dates the [[death]] of [[Ponds]], as seen in the episode "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," to the same [[Standard year|year]]. Since {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} places "[[The Deserter]]" between "Landing at Point Rain" and "Lethal Trackdown," its events must take place in the same year. the Clone Wars came to Lawquane's home of Saleucami. Separatist [[General]] [[Grievous]] intended to [[Planetary assault tactics|invade]] the planet, however, during the [[Battle of Saleucami]], his [[C-9979 landing craft|landing craft]] was shot down by the [[Galactic Republic]], forcing him and his droids to flee to the planet surface in [[escape pod]]s. The Republic then landed on the surface, where [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and several squads of [[clone trooper]]s took to [[speeder bike]]s in order to find the wreckage of Grievous's escape pod. [[File:Lawquane_farm.png|thumb|right|275px|The Lawquane farm.]] As the Republic's hunt for the general commenced, [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] was injured by a [[BX-series droid commando|commando droid sniper]]. Rather than call off the search, [[Kix]], the team [[medic]], decided to find a place for Rex to recover overnight. As the squad debated where to take him, they realized the surrounding eopies were domesticated, and followed them until they came across the Lawquane family's farm. As they approached the farm, Cut's wife, Suu Lawquane burst out of the farmhouse, brandishing a [[blaster rifle]]. After [[Jesse]] explained the situation, Suu offered a bench in the barn for Rex to recover on, where they applied a [[bacta patch]] to his wound. As Suu brought in [[Foodstuff|food]] for Rex, Shaeeah Lawquane lost control of her [[repulsorlift]] ball, and ran in after it. Upon seeing Rex, she remarked on the similarity between him and her father, Cut. Suu explained that Cut was delivering their first harvest, and was gone at the time. Rex's squad left, and resumed their search for General Grievous. When Cut returned from delivering the harvest, he entered the barn, only to see a stranger inside. Lawquane cautiously entered the barn, arming himself with a [[staff]], slowly raising it up at the stranger. Rex heard the footsteps, and pulled a [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|blaster pistol]] on him, which Lawquane swiftly knocked from his hand. Rex and Cut immediately recognized each other as clones. Rex quickly got upset at Cut, and accused him of deserting the Republic Army. As Rex confronted Cut, Shaeeah and Jek ran in, and began talking with their father. Jek showed Cut his drawing, while Shaeeah mentioned her encounter with Rex. When Suu explained the situation to Cut, he said that of course Rex could spend the night, and Jek agreed, saying that they would always help anyone they can. [[File:LawquaneFamilyTD.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Cut prepares to fight the droids, while his family hides.]] At dinner, which was a [[roast nuna]], Rex conversed with Cut, debating the ethics of deserting the army they were born to serve. During the conversation, Rex asked is his choice to continue serving matched with Cut's approval. Cut agreed, say that everyone should be able to do whatever they want with their life. Later, over a game of [[Dejarik]], the two continued their conversation. Cut defended himself by telling Rex his story, but Rex remained resentful towards him. After they finished their chores, Cut's two children asked their father if they could play outside. Cut agreed, as long as they stayed within sight of the house. The children ran through the nearby crop field, where they discovered a droid escape pod from the battle overhead. While exploring it, Shaeeah accidentally hit a button with her elbow, activating the group of BX-series droid commandos stored inside. The children ran back to the house, where Cut identified the droids. Cut knew Rex was injured, and volunteered to take on the droids himself, leaving Rex as the last line of defense for his family. Cut gave Rex a [[blaster pistol]], while Cut took his own [[DC-15A blaster carbine]] to fight the droids. Rex and the family fled to the upper level, while Cut stayed to battle the droids. Cut skillfully killed the majority of the droids, but ended up getting trapped under debris. The [[Battle droid|droids]] then progressed upstairs, chasing after the rest of the family. As Rex defended the family, Cut freed himself, and the two defeated the remaining droids together. Because of their experience together, Rex and Cut developed and understanding of each other's motives. [[File:RexLawquaneAndFamily.jpg|thumb|225x225px|The Lawquanes watch Rex depart.]] In the morning, Rex had recovered enough to return to his squad. As he prepared to leave, Cut offered him a place in their family. Rex declined, saying that his family was elsewhere. When Suu worriedly asked if Rex would turn Cut in, Rex agreed not to, using his injury as an excuse to feign amnesia in his report. Rex rode off on an eopie, as the Lawquanes saw him off. At some point afterward, Cut met and became acquainted with [[Clone Force 99]].{{TBB|Cut and Run}} ===The Imperial Era=== {{Quote|What do we have here? More clones who have lost their way.''"
"''It's been a while, fellas.|Suu and Cut Lawquane upon the arrival of the Bad Batch|}} In [[19 BBY]], following [[Order 66]], Rex arrived on Saleucami. Cut and Rex spoke, and the latter informed him of the [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]] that caused the clone army to [[Death|kill]] the [[Jedi Order|Jedi]]. He warned Cut of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire]], and Cut decided to leave Saleucami for a safer planet. Rex then left, but did not inform Cut of his destination. [[File:CutandSuuTBB.png|left|thumb|225x225px|Cut and Suu talk to the Bad Batch about Rex's visit the day prior.]] The next [[Standard day|day]], Clone Force 99 arrived on Saleucami to meet with Cut and his family for advice on how to stay off the grid as deserters. The Lawquances soon became aware of their new visitors when Wrecker accidentally tripped several inanimate battle droids they had set up against intruder and approached the squad with their blaster rifle. While his wife remarked they had found more lost clones, Cut admitted they hadn't seen each other for some time. Moving back inside their dwelling, Hunter introduced Cut and his family to [[Echo]] and [[Omega]]. Cut asked where [[Crosshair]] was, but [[Hunter]] only told him it was complicated to explain, not telling him that Crosshair betrayed the group and joined the Empire. Cut then informed them of Rex's visit the day prior and how he informed them of the "behaviorial implant" that caused all clones to turn on the Jedi. Echo, who had once served under Rex, asked where his former commanding officer went, but Cut couldn't provide any information. Omega, on the other hand, revealed her knowledge of the inhibitor chips. The conversation was then interrupted by Shaeeah and Jek, who rushed in to tell their stepfather of their sighting of the ''Marauder''. After they were happily reunited with their "Uncle Wrecker" and went outside to play with Omega, Cut asked Hunter why the girl was accompanying the Bad Batch. When told that Omega was a defective clone like them, Cut disagreed, reminding that the Kaminoans don't create clones without a purpose and questioned what purpose she served. Hunter insisted it was irrelevant, given her age. Cut cautioned that fighting droids was easy compared to raising a child and teased it would be more difficult for the squad to handle. Hunter argued they had no choice but to rescue her from Kamino. Cut then told him of his plans to flee Saleucami, but declined Hunter's offer to take them offworld in their [[Starship|ship]], believing it would be too dangerous for his family to travel with wanted fugitives. Cut and Hunter later travel to the [[spaceport]] in civilian clothing, observing that clone troopers were occupying the town and impounding all ships. When asked where his next destination was, Cut answered that all his family needed was a remote planet to hide on. Hearing Hunter asking if his squad should do the same, Cut told him that the only way to continue unnoticed was to abandon military life and become a civilian. Unfortunately, the [[Aleen]] vendor they met with to book offworld passage informed them that the Empire had implemented a new policy requiring [[chain code]]s for legal passage. Being a clone, Cut would be unable to present proper identification without being discovered as a deserter. Returning to the farm, Cut sat with Suu and the Bad Batch as they discussed the chain codes. As he stressed that they need to be on the next shuttle, Shaeeah and Jek ran in and frantically informed the adults that Omega had went out past the fence to retrieve a ball. They all rushed outside to witness Omega being stalked by a [[nexu]], which was driven off by Hunter and Suu. With the danger over, Cut intervened when Hunter harshly scolded Omega, reminding that she wasn't a soldier before comforting the young girl and carrying her back inside the house. This experience led Hunter to believe that he and his team were inadequate guardians for Omega, and he asked Cut and Suu to take her with them off world. [[File:SaleucamiTownCheckpoint-CaR.png|thumb|right|275px|Cut Lawquane submits his chain codes for inspection to depart Saleucami.]] Meanwhile, Echo and [[Tech]] devised a plan to intentionally get their ship impounded and delivered to the dock, where they could create fake chain codes. Unbeknownst to Tech and Echo, however, Omega was sheltering on the ship following her encounter with the nexu. By the time Hunter found out and told the two, the plan was already in motion. Echo and Tech successfully retrieved chain codes, but still had to deliver them to the Lawquanes, who were on the other side of the spaceport. With the amount of clones present, Tech and Echo would be unable to cross in time. Omega took the chain codes, and began crossing the area, placing herself in harm's way. [[Wrecker]] saved Omega, and went to provide aid for Echo and Tech, while Omega continued towards the Lawquanes. When she arrived to present the chain codes, she remarked that there was an extra one, and Cut was stunned that Hunter did not tell her of the agreement. Hunter told Omega, and she reluctantly went with the Lawquanes. However, a few moments later, Omega decided to disobey Hunter and ran back to their ship just as they were making their getaway. As Cut was boarding the transport vessel, he was stopped by a clone, who began to recognize him, but was called away to help corral the Bad Batch, allowing Cut to board with his family. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|Both of you, picking sides. Side you should pick is your family. No matter what. Above all else. But here you sit, bickering like a bunch of starkles over which one gets the first and last worm. You know the Lawquanes? Old man Cut, he fought in the Clone Wars. He saw the truth of things: No side in war is the right side. He did the right thing. Settled down. Had a family. Never got drawn back into the muck.|Glen Taffral, to his children|[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] }} In [[18 BBY]], Omega and Wrecker recall Cut and Suu when they discovered another clone named [[Ponder]] had married [[Sohi]], though Tech reminded that the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] wasn't tracking the Lawquances for robbing a [[Canto Bight]] casino, and Hunter added that the Lawquances didn't try to deceive them either.''[[Sanctuary: A Bad Batch Novel]]'' After the [[Battle of Endor]], [[Glen Taffral]], who lived on Saleucami, mentioned Cut as an example of someone who left war, and instead prioritized his family. Rex wrote about Cut in his book ''[[The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]''.''[[Star Wars: The Secrets of the Clone Troopers]]'' ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|To each his own. That's what I always say.''"
"''What does that mean, Daddy?''"
"''It means you can do anything with your life that you want to.|Cut and Shaeeah Lawquane|}} [[File:CutLawquane-Db.png|thumb|250px|right|Lawquane chose a life of a peaceful farmer, but would take up arms to defend his family.]] As a human clone, Cut Lawquane shared his face with Jango Fett and stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall.{{Databank|clone-troopers|Clone Troopers}} He was fit, with broad shoulders, fair skin, and brown eyes. He had medium length [[hair]] that was [[Color|reddish-brown]] in color and pulled into a ponytail. While many clones had [[tattoo]]s, Cut had no visible tattoos. By the time of the Galactic Empire, Cut had grown out his sideburns and had his hair pulled back in a bun. ===An individual=== {{Quote|My ''name'' is Lawquane. Cut Lawquane.|Cut, after Rex demands him to tell this designation number.|audio=LawquaneCutLawquane-TD.flac|}} After deserting, Cut became disillusioned with the Republic Army. He defied his programming and began to exercise his free will, making the choice to not kill for a living. As he fell in love and got married, this ideal developed. He deeply believed that everyone should get a free choice in what they want to do with their life. When he was confronted by Rex, he held fast to this belief, defending his decision to desert the Republic. Despite this, he fully accepted Rex's decision to remain in the army, saying it fit with his approval perfectly. He was determined to always help anyone he could, an ideal he passed on to his children. He went as far to offer Rex the same choice he made, offering Rex a place within the Lawquane family. Despite his individuality, his past memories of battle and war haunted him, even years after their occurrence. ===A devoted husband and father=== {{Quote|Battling droids was easy compared to raising a child.|Cut, to Hunter|}} Cut was determined to protect his family, putting them above all else. He shared a close relationship with his wife, Suu, along with his two adoptive children, Shaeeah and Jek. When their farm was attacked by commando droids during the Battle of Saleucami, Cut protected his family fearlessly, willing to give up his own life to preserve those of his family. He comforted his terrified children, and prepared to fight the droids with no hesitation. Although Rex could have assisted him, Cut instead had Rex remain upstairs with his family, as a last line of defense. Before he departed, Rex commended his devotion, saying that while he still is a deserter, he was no coward. When the Empire rose, Cut knew that he had to move his family off Saleucami instead of allow himself to be discovered. When they were visited by Clone Force 99, Cut was surprised to see the group of soldiers with a child, Omega. When Omega accidentally placed herself in danger by going outside the fence and was attacked by a nexu, Hunter initially berated her, but Cut warned him not to treat her like a soldier and instead consoled her before hugging her and carrying her inside. ==Skills and abilities== Cut Lawquane was skilled in armed and unarmed combat, military tactics, reconnaissance and farming. ==Equipment== [[File:YouStoleMyFace-TD.png|thumb|left|275px|Cut Lawquane wielding his staff against Rex]] Cut wore a dark green tunic with brown accents, along with baggy beige pants. Underneath, he wore a lighter green [[shirt]]. On top, he also wore a beige sash and a brown [[belt]] with large attached pouches. He wore light brown fingerless [[glove]]s and light brown [[boot]]s. Cut wielded a pointed staff, a DC-15A blaster carbine and a [[DC-15A blaster rifle]], [[macrobinoculars]] and a DC-17 hand blaster he lent to Rex. He also used Suu's antique [[slugthrower]] [[6-2Aug2 hunting rifle]].{{HelmetCollectionCite|66|Weapons & Uniforms}} Cut owned multiple eopies, which he kept in his barn and occasionally used as mounts. ==Behind the scenes== Cut Lawquane first appeared in "[[The Deserter]]," a [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season 2]] episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]],'' which aired on [[January 1]], [[2010]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], the same voice actor as other clones in the series.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode210.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Deserter}} He was indirectly mentioned in "[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]"{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} and appeared in "[[Cut and Run]]," both episodes from the [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]].'' The episodes aired on [[May 4]], [[2021]] and [[May 7]], 2021 respectively. [[Pablo Hidalgo]], a creative executive and author for [[Lucasfilm]],''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]'' mentioned on his Twitter that while Shaeeah and Jek have a human father, their biological father is not Cut.{{Twitter|pablohidalgo|status/703719160757383168|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2016-02-27|quote=They're not Cut's children, biologically, but they did have a human father. [...] It wasn't said, but it was part of their character design.|archivefile=File:PabloHidalgo-CutsChildren-Twitter.jpg|nolive=1}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Cut Lawquane|imagecat=Images of Cut Lawquane}} *{{TCW|The Deserter}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} {{Imo}} *{{TBB|Cut and Run}} *''[[Sanctuary: A Bad Batch Novel]]'' {{Mo}} *[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']] {{Ab|Aftermath (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== {{ScrollBox| *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode210.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Deserter}} *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]] *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Five|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Five]] *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-deserter-episode-guide|text="The Deserter" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{SWE|characters|rex|Clone Captain Rex}} *{{SWE|characters|cutlawquane|Cut Lawquane}} *{{SWE|characters|jesse|Jesse}} *{{SWE|characters|nuna|nuna}} *{{SWE|locations|saleucami|Saleucami}} *{{SW|url=news/die-wanna-wanga-encounters-of-the-twilek-kind|text=Die Wanna Wanga: Encounters of The Twi'lek Kind|nolive=1}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|36|Databank A-Z}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *{{BuildFalconCite|44|Guide to the Galaxy}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|48|Databank A-Z}} *''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *{{InsiderCite|187|Clone Tales}} *''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia -
